$comment: Every corpus document the interpreter builds through esm_problem and native does not, with native's refusal. The list only shrinks: a document missing from it that native refuses is RED, and an entry native now builds is RED until it is removed. See README.md in this directory.

entries.reason: compiler_refused_rule: compiler=:native refuses 'Field.darea': the whole-array setup materializer resolves and compiles the expression once per cell, over 3 cells, because the compile-once form declined it. That is a tree walk per cell at construction time, which esm-libraries-spec §2.5.10 puts under the same rule as the right-hand side. Build with compiler=:interpreter to run it
